He asks for ID first.

Other nights on the board

What people said after the door opened.

4.8 from 212 reviews Sample rating

  • LOCKOUT

    Locked myself out of our upper flat at 11 p.m. in January. They said the price range on the phone, texted me the tech's name and a grey van, and he checked my ID before he opened anything. Picked, not drilled. Receipt matched.

    Renata W., Milwaukee Sample review

  • CAR

    Remote start was running and the doors locked with the fob inside. It was about minus eight. The tech had the door open in a few minutes and didn't touch the paint.

    Darnell P., Wauwatosa Sample review

  • FROZEN

    Our side door lock froze solid after a sleet storm. He warmed it, blew the water out and showed me which lubricant to use next time instead of the oil I'd been spraying in there.

    Kathy B., West Allis Sample review

  • REKEY

    Rekeyed five locks the week we closed, front, back, side, garage entry and the basement door. All on one key now. The price landed inside the range they quoted.

    Tomasz L., Greenfield Sample review

  • DUPLEX

    We own a duplex in Bay View. He set it up so each unit has its own key and the shared basement takes both. The tenants were happy not to share keys anymore.

    Mei S., Milwaukee Sample review

  • KEY

    Key snapped in the front lock while my hands were full of groceries. Got it out, cut me a new one from the broken halves, done in twenty minutes.

    Andre J., Cudahy Sample review
